item.title: At least 10 killed, including five foreign nationals, in clashes during a crackdown on illegal gold mining in Guinea
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Guinea. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Guinean security forces and miners (clashes during a crackdown). Reported casualties: 10 killed. Disputed or caveats: Circumstances and responsibility unclear; injured include civilians and others. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0634
